faq.q: Where is the grocery store in the centre of Tsawwassen?
faq.a: Thrifty Foods, on the Tsawwassen Town Centre Mall site; the City lists the site addresses as 1219 56 Street, 5499 12 Avenue and 1236 55 Street.

faq.q: Who can help me buy or sell in Tsawwassen Central?

faq.q: How do I find out which school serves an address in Tsawwassen Central?
faq.a: School catchments are set by address, so use the school district's catchment locator with the exact address. Catchment lines change, so check before you write an offer.

faq.q: Do I need a home inspection when buying in Tsawwassen Central?
faq.a: It is strongly recommended. Make the offer subject to an inspection so a qualified inspector can look at the roof, structure, drainage, electrical and heating before you remove conditions.
